title: POWER ( 5, 2 ) is the decimal number 25

source.supports: POWER(5,2) is 25; the page's return value is a decimal number

source.quote: The exponentiation operator ^ returns the same result as the POWER function
source.supports: ^ is POWER, and the page gives POWER's return value as a single decimal value

derivation: The Microsoft page shows POWER(5,2) returning 25 and gives the return value as a decimal number: the double 25.0.
alternative: Neither page shows the type for integer arguments. If integer arguments give an integer, the result is the int64 25.
